top_signals.title: China Condemns Japan’s ‘Negative Moves’ Over Yasukuni Shrine
top_signals.summary: China strongly condemned what it called Japan’s “negative moves” concerning the Yasukuni Shrine, saying the actions were a provocation against the postwar international order, according to a Saturday statement from the Chinese Embassy in Japan.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Takaichi’s support rate falls below 50%, lowest since taking office, Kyodo reports
top_signals.summary: The decline might have been affected by Takaichi's slow response surrounding the resignation of Kazuo Yana as the nation's farm minister.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
